name: Sslyth

bonuses.name: Sslyth Limbs
bonuses.text: A Slyth has 2 sets of limbs, reducing the Multi-Attack and Multi-Action penalty by 2 DN.

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this Threat must make a DN 1 Fear Test.

abilities.name: Cold Blooded Bodyguard
abilities.text: When an Archon the Sslyth is the bodyguard of within 8m is targeted by an attack, this Threat may interpose themself as a reaction and become the new target for the attack.

determination: Resilient Species: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 4d6. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
note: Print: skills are printed "Awareness 86 (Passive 3)" and "Ballistic Skill 84". Both stored as printed (likely Awareness 6, as Passive 3 fits it, and Ballistic Skill 8); the bonus spells the name "Slyth".
